assumption_statement: Users will contribute and reuse knowledge consistently
Knowledge reuse will improve decision quality
Affected stakeholders will view the redesign process as legitimate
Service redesign will not shift burden to frontline workers
Decision-makers will use foresight outputs in real decisions
Scenario readiness will improve strategic resilience
Targets will improve outcomes rather than metric gaming
Short-term metric movement reflects real progress
AI suggestions will improve idea quality rather than amplify weak frames
Human review will remain accountable and disciplined
Cross-functional governance will reduce alignment drift
Portfolio governance will stop weak pilots instead of defending them
Teams will use equity review as decision input rather than compliance ritual
Burden and harm can be made visible before implementation
